questions.explanation: The cardinality of a set is the number of distinct elements it contains. The set {1,2,3,4,5} has exactly 5 elements, so its cardinality is 5.

questions.question_text: Power set of {a,b} has how many elements?
questions.explanation: The power set contains all possible subsets of {a,b}: the empty set ∅, {a}, {b}, and {a,b}. That's 4 subsets total. For any set with n elements, the power set has 2^n elements; here 2^2 = 4.

questions.question_text: Probability of rolling sum 7 with two dice:
questions.explanation: There are 6 ways to roll a sum of 7: (1,6), (2,5), (3,4), (4,3), (5,2), (6,1). With 36 total possible outcomes when rolling two dice, the probability is 6/36, which simplifies to 1/6.

questions.question_text: Two events A, B with P(A) = 0.3, P(B) = 0.4, P(A∪B) = 0.6. P(A∩B):
questions.explanation: Using the formula P(A∪B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A∩B), we substitute: 0.6 = 0.3 + 0.4 - P(A∩B), which gives P(A∩B) = 0.7 - 0.6 = 0.1.
